Symfony Polyfills
=================
Symfony polyfill packages bundled for laminas-mail.

Contents
--------
- polyfill-intl-idn – Intl IDN polyfill.
- polyfill-intl-normalizer – Intl Normalizer polyfill.
- polyfill-mbstring – Mbstring polyfill.
- polyfill-php72 – PHP 7.2 polyfill utilities.

Notes
-----
- Each polyfill folder includes upstream README and license files; consult them for details.
- Vendor code; avoid local modifications.
